import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v1)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v3)) (h2 : (0 < p2v2)) (h3 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v4)) (h4 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v2)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v4) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.trans Nat _ p2v0 p2v1 p2v4 h0 h3

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v1)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v3)) (h2 : (0 < p2v2)) (h3 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v4)) (h4 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v2)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v3) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.trans Nat _ p2v0 p2v4 p2v3 (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4) h1

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v1)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v3)) (h2 : (0 < p2v2)) (h3 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v4)) (h4 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v2)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.trans Nat _ p2v0 p2v3 p2v2 (p2_n002 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4) h4
